newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada's Ontario removes Consumers' rules.
newsitem.headline: Canada's Ontario removes Consumers' rules.

text.p: Consumers' Gas Co Ltd, which is 85 percent owned by IPL Energy Inc, said on Friday that it received Ontario government approval for major moves, including the requirement of a 15 percent public float.
The amendment clears the way for IPL to offer to buy out Consumers' minority shareholders and change it into a wholly owned subsidiary.

Consumers' said its board of directors formed a special committee and hired financial advisers to discuss a proposal with IPL. Consumers' said its directors had yet to receive a formal proposal from IPL.
The company said it also gained a diversification exemption permit from Ontario that would allow it to participate in a potential water supply and waste water project in the province's Halton region.
A similar permit was granted for the York region in 1995.

Consumers' said the amendments to the diversification restrictions would enhance the ability of IPL and Consumers' to undertake water projects using combined management and technical skills and IPL's financial resources. -- Reuters Calgary Bureau 403 531-1624
